run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T17:40:53Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is backed by real error spans in frontend-proxy: over the 71-minute window, span 'ingress' STATUS_CODE_ERROR increased ~528 and span 'router frontend egress' (frontend-proxy's call to the frontend) ~513.8. Those frontend-proxy errors track a failure inside the frontend's ads path: frontend's own error spans are GET /api/data (~508.7), 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' (~508.8), the client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (~508.8) and tcp.connect (~17.3), while its cart/checkout operations show 0 errors. The deepest supported cause is the ad workload: pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 (owner ReplicaSet ad-554b849958, Deployment ad) had its container 'ad' OOMKilled at 17:40:22Z (exit code 137) against a 450Mi memory limit and restarted at 17:40:23Z; after that restart the container produced no request logs after 17:40:19Z, emitted no oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server spans from 17:45:53Z on (0 through the end of the window), and sat pinned at its 50m CPU limit (~0.0497 cores, ~5-10 throttled CFS periods/s) with memory climbing again to ~282Mi working set / ~378Mi max. Frontend's GetAds client spans flipped from STATUS_CODE_UNSET to STATUS_CODE_ERROR (all calls failing, ~0.6-0.99/s) starting around 17:41-17:42Z, ~1 minute after the OOM kill and 30 s after the alert's reported start (17:40:53Z). frontend-proxy's pod itself did not restart and its error spans mirror the frontend upstream 5xx, so its error rate is a downstream symptom, not an independent failure. cart, currency, email, product-catalog and shipping show no error spans at all despite heavy traffic; nodes report no MemoryPressure. The in-container mechanism for ad not serving after restart (CPU-starved JVM startup vs. GC thrash vs. hang) is not resolvable from the visible telemetry.

claims.text: frontend-proxy recorded STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans in the query window: span 'ingress' increased ~528.0 and span 'router frontend egress' ~513.8 over 71m, while the corresponding STATUS_CODE_UNSET increases were ~23476.7 and ~23490.9.

frontend-proxy's 5m error rate was ~0.004-0.011/s until the 17:41:53Z point, rose to 0.2625/s at 17:42:53Z and ~0.84/s by 17:46:53Z, and was still 0.637/s at 17:51:53Z; both 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' moved together (egress was 0 before 17:41:53Z).

In the frontend service the only request errors over the 71m window are on the ads path: 'GET /api/data' (~508.7), 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' (~508.8), client span 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' (~508.8) and 'tcp.connect' (~17.3); 'GET /api/cart', 'POST /api/cart', 'POST /api/checkout', CartService and CheckoutService error series are 0.

frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds kept a near-constant total rate (~0.8-0.9/s) but its STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate fell from ~0.8/s to 0.0148/s at 17:45:53Z and 0 from 17:46:53Z, while STATUS_CODE_ERROR rose from 0.254/s at 17:42:53Z to ~0.99/s at 17:49:53Z and 0.615/s at 17:51:53Z — i.e. essentially all GetAds calls were failing at the end of the window.

The container 'ad' of pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 has restartCount 1 and lastState.terminated.reason OOMKilled with exitCode 137, startedAt 17:03:21Z and finishedAt 2026-11-16T17:40:22Z; the container was running again from 2026-11-16T17:40:23Z.

Deployment ad (otel-demo) runs 1 replica of image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad with container resources limits cpu 50m / memory 450Mi, requests cpu 10m / memory 225Mi, and no readiness or liveness probe; its status shows readyReplicas 1 and its Available condition lastTransitionTime is 2026-11-16T17:40:23Z.

Pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 currently reports phase Running, all conditions True including Ready and ContainersReady, container ad ready=true, podIP 100.96.4.112 — surface state is healthy even though the service was not serving GetAds.

Service 'ad' maps port 8080 to targetPort 8080 with selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad, and its Endpoints object contains address 100.96.4.112:8080 for pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 — so the routing objects are not empty; the pod is registered as an endpoint.

The ad container's readable log stream ends at 2026-11-16T17:40:19.817405Z (read_through and source_end_at both 17:40:19.817405Z), i.e. no ad log lines were retained in the ~12 minutes after the 17:40:23Z restart; the stream only contains per-request lines such as 'Targeted ad request received for [...]' and 'no baggage found in context', the last such request log being before the OOM kill.

ad's server-side span rate for oteldemo.AdService/GetAds was ~0.78-0.85/s up to the 17:40:53Z point, decayed to 0.148/s at 17:44:53Z and was exactly 0 from 17:45:53Z through 17:51:53Z; getAdsByCategory and getRandomAds likewise went to 0 — ad served no GetAds requests after the restart.

ad's GetAds p95 latency (histogram_quantile over traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket) was ~80-320ms from 17:16:53Z to 17:40:53Z, climbed to 301ms/366ms/593ms/1000ms at 17:40:53Z-17:43:53Z, then became NaN from 17:44:53Z onward because no GetAds observations remained.

The restarted ad container (container id ...ed742b64...) is pinned at its CPU limit: rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[2m]) rose from 0.0123 to a steady ~0.0494-0.0497 cores (limit is 50m) between 17:41:53Z and 17:49:53Z, while rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total[5m]) rose to ~9-10 throttled periods/s over 17:45:53Z-17:49:53Z.

ad container memory: the pre-restart container (id ...a9304b54...) held ~301-311MB working set and jumped to ~420MB at the 17:40:53Z point (max usage 420.8MB against the 450Mi limit); the post-restart container (id ...ed742b64...) went from 57MB at 17:40:53Z to ~282-315MB working set by 17:49:53Z-17:51:53Z with max usage 378.3MB.

Kubelet events for ad-554b849958-fcl25 show 'Pulled', 'Created container: ad' and 'Started container ad' each with count 2 and last occurrences at 17:40:22Z/17:40:23Z, matching the single container restart; there is no Evicted event and no further restart.
No node-level memory pressure explains the kill: all 5 nodes are Ready with MemoryPressure=False and KubeletHasSufficientMemory, including i-06e4f0f4f681d7e45 where the ad pod runs.

Other services on the same traffic path show no request errors: cart (36613 spans), currency (3748), email (5326), product-catalog (24713) and shipping (3995) have spans in the window and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series at all; checkout, payment and accounting return 0 for their error series; recommendation's only errors are 4.06 on '/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' (a flag-provider stream, not a request path).

All 21 otel-demo pods are phase Running with 0 restarts except ad-554b849958-fcl25 (1) and fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-wbm7f (1); the fraud-detection container was OOMKilled (exit 137) at 17:17:54Z, ~23 minutes before this incident's error onset, and its only error spans are 1.03 on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream with 0 on flagd ResolveInt — no request-path errors.

frontend-proxy's total span rate stayed flat at roughly 19-21/s across the window (so the rising error counts are not a traffic increase), while its error rate series shows the increase after 17:41:53Z.

Primary causal chain: Deployment ad's container exceeded its 450Mi memory limit and was OOMKilled at 17:40:22Z; after the 17:40:23Z restart the same container is pinned at its 50m CPU limit and serves no GetAds calls, so frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans fail, /api/data returns 5xx, and frontend-proxy records ingress + 'router frontend egress' error spans — which is the RequestErrorRate alert. Temporal alignment: kill 17:40:22Z, alert reported start 17:40:53Z, error rate first rising at the 17:41:53Z reading and saturated by ~17:45:53Z.

Secondary candidate for the post-restart non-serving state: the ad JVM is CPU-starved/GC-bound under the 50m CPU and 450Mi limits (usage sat at ~99% of the CPU limit with ~10 throttled periods/s and memory climbing back toward the limit) rather than simply taking a long time to accept connections. Visible telemetry cannot distinguish startup starvation from a hung or GC-thrashing JVM, and the container is not being OOMKilled again (restartCount remains 1).

Rejected: frontend-proxy (Envoy) as the origin. Its error spans appear only on 'ingress' and on 'router frontend egress' toward the frontend, its own pod shows 0 restarts and Running, its total span rate is unchanged, and the matching errors exist inside frontend (GET /api/data, AdService/GetAds) — so frontend-proxy is reporting its upstream's failures, not producing them.

Rejected: the flagd EventStream span errors as the cause. The same 'EventStream' STATUS_CODE_ERROR pattern appears for ad (2.04), fraud-detection (1.03) and recommendation (4.06) over the window, and none of those services show request-path errors; the frontend failures are specifically on the AdService GetAds call, not on flag resolution.

Treat Deployment ad (otel-demo) as the object to fix: review/raise the ad container's memory limit (450Mi) and CPU limit (50m), investigate the pre-kill memory growth to ~420MB, and confirm whether the restarted container reaches a serving state; add a readiness probe to ad so the Deployment/Endpoints stop routing to a container that is Running but not serving (there are currently no readiness or liveness probes).

After ad is serving again, verify that the frontend's gRPC channel to ad reconnects and that frontend-proxy's 'router frontend egress' error spans and GET /api/data 5xx stop; if errors persist after ad serves spans again, investigate the frontend gRPC client (it showed only 17.3 tcp.connect error spans versus ~509 failed GetAds calls, consistent with a channel failing fast rather than reconnecting).

gaps: The RequestErrorRate rule definition is not retrievable: list_prometheus_rules returned no rules for rule_name=RequestErrorRate and no rules unfiltered, so the exact expression, threshold and the reported value 1.5333 could not be reproduced from the visible series; no http_server_request_duration_seconds_count series exists for frontend-proxy (get_all_labels/get_label_values returned no data), so the alert's metric source is unconfirmed.

No application logs exist from the post-restart ad container (readable stream ends at 17:40:19.817Z) and no JVM heap/GC metrics are available, so the reason ad serves no GetAds after the restart (slow CPU-throttled startup vs GC thrash vs hung process) cannot be determined; the in-container listening socket could not be inspected.

Jaeger returned no traces for frontend, frontend-proxy or ad in the query window (three searches returned zero traces), so span-level gRPC status codes, error messages and parent-child call edges for this incident are unknown; the call chain was inferred only from per-span metric series and shared error counts.

Frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-cmhqq produced no readable log lines in the window (fetch_pod_logs returned status no_data for the current and previous instances), so the exact gRPC error text from the frontend is unavailable.

The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so it is unknown whether the ad Deployment's resource limits or image were changed recently; the pod's creation time equals the namespace-wide start (17:03:18Z), which shows no rollout during the incident.
Not verified: whether ad eventually recovers (the query window ends 17:52:06Z) and whether any customer-facing failure beyond the frontend /api/data 5xx exists.
next_steps: Have a human inspect the ad Deployment's resource limits and the ad container's live state (kubectl describe pod ad-554b849958-fcl25, kubectl logs --previous/current, container exec/netstat on port 8080) to establish whether the restarted JVM is listening; no such action is performed here.
Recover the RequestErrorRate alerting rule from Alertmanager/Prometheus configuration to confirm the exact expression, threshold and denominator behind the reported 1.5333.

Review whether ad's 450Mi memory limit and 50m CPU limit are appropriate for image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad and whether a readiness probe should be added so traffic is not sent to a Running-but-not-serving container.

After ad is serving again, confirm recovery by checking that ad's oteldemo.AdService/GetAds span rate returns to ~0.8/s, that frontend's GetAds error spans stop, and that frontend-proxy's ingress/egress error rates return to baseline.
